person_note: The diagnostic quote q01091 shows close third-person access to the focal character, while the remaining narrative quotes are too impersonal or brief to identify person securely. Authorized opening prose independently establishes third-person narration, and explicit section-level and whole-book analyses describe close or restricted third person with occasional broader third-person passages. The first-person wording visible inside the authorized excerpt is marked as Clay's direct thought, not controlling narration. No evidence indicates sustained narration in another person; the main limitation is that the authorized prose is opening-only, mitigated by the whole-book POV description and corroborating Goodreads passage.
